Name: Credit Risk Form
Info: I built a full-stack credit risk prediction application that allows users to input financial and personal information and receive real-time probability estimates of default. The frontend was developed using React and Material-UI (MUI) to create a clean, responsive, and user-friendly interface, while the backend was implemented with Flask to handle API requests and serve model predictions. I trained and evaluated machine learning models using Scikit-learn on a real-world Kaggle dataset, applying data preprocessing and classification techniques to generate accurate risk assessments.

Name: Automated Counting Software
Info: I helped develop an automated counting software that uses computer vision to count objects in images. I implemented the frontend and created a user-friendly interface for uploading videos, counting results, and downloading reports. In addition, I integrated a CI/CD pipeline using AWS Amplify for seamless deployment and updates.

Name: News Sentiment Analysis
Info: I developed a sentiment analysis tool that processes news articles using Python and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. The tool fetches articles from various sources, analyzes sentiment to find trends.

Name: Trading Bot
Info: I built a trading bot that runs on Google Cloud Functions with a scheduler that triggers execution once every hour. The bot fetches real-time market data from the Alpaca API, processes trading logic, and automates buy/sell decisions without manual intervention. This serverless setup ensures scalability, low maintenance, and reliable execution of trades on schedule.

Name: Racing Game
Info: I developed a 3D racing game using Unity and C#. The game features realistic physics simulation, AI pathfinding for opponents, and a progression system that enhances gameplay.
